scientific_integrity: Mathematical identities and the small-forcing periodic-orbit existence argument are proved in RESULT.md. Finite symbolic and ODE tests are corroborative, not exhaustive or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary time-mean deficit is claimed only for pairwise groups; the general-group identity is weighted by defector payoff. The periodic-orbit branch exists locally for weak sinusoidal forcing at stated parameters. No global attraction, arbitrary-forcing existence, or stochastic-process conclusion. The 2023 supplementary sensitivity material could not be fully inspected, leaving bibliographic uncertainty.
title: A payoff-weighted cooperation law and a strict seasonal mean deficit in pairwise eco-evolutionary games
